comment: agent-auth AUTH-S2 policy (DESIGN.md 4.1, 4.2). Longest-prefix match on (method, path); ties go to the rule with a methods list; unmatched routes fall to default_scope.

public.why: Health and discovery endpoints are open.

read.hints.hint: Use GET /hints or /query for repo knowledge.

memory.write.why: Memory writes persist and influence later agents, so they are provenance-stamped.
memory.write.hint: Write through the sanctioned memory path from your agent socket class.

research.fetch.why: Server-side URL fetch can bypass a sandbox network policy.
research.fetch.hint: Use GET /hints or /query for repo questions; request an egress grant for external pages.

orchestrate.why: Orchestration spawns or steers agents and consumes inference.
orchestrate.hint: Run orchestration from the owner agent class.

qa.run.why: QA and eval runs execute host subprocesses.
qa.run.hint: Run aq-qa from the owner shell.

safety.tighten.why: Safety mode may only be ratcheted up by sandboxed callers.
safety.tighten.hint: Raise the session safety mode; lowering needs the owner.

safety.loosen.why: Loosening safety controls or registering hooks needs owner approval.
safety.loosen.hint: Ask the owner to approve via aq-approve.

agent.events.why: Agent event bus access is scoped.
agent.events.hint: Use the agent event endpoints from your agent class.

admin.why: Administrative and unclassified routes need the admin class.
admin.hint: Use a documented route family or ask the owner.

decide.why: Local decision oracle evaluation (aq-decide DEC-S8). Restricted to prevent agent privilege probing.
decide.hint: Only internal monitor and admin processes may query the decision engine.

rules.note: GET reads on write families; design 4.1 lists POST only for memory.write.
Not listed in design 4.1; assigned in S2 to keep existing loopback access visible, review during the shadow soak.
Not listed in design 4.1; assigned in S2 to keep existing loopback access visible, review during the shadow soak.
Tighten-versus-loosen distinction is content-based and arrives with S5 (monotonic rule).
DEC-S8: Decision oracle endpoint. Granted to no agent class by default.

class_notes.legacy-loopback: All TCP callers until S3 lands the UDS peer identity. memory.write is a 90-day compat grant (design 4.2).
class_notes.api-key: Design 5.3: under enforce the api-key mode maps to {admin} only; non-admin api-key traffic in the shadow log is the S7 migration signal.
